title: Meet Nepal

body.heading: Where in the world is Nepal?
paragraphs: Nepal is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Nepal is Kathmandu.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Nepal is Nepali.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Nepal is the Nepalese rupee.

body.heading: How big is Nepal?
paragraphs: Nepal covers about 147,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Oman.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Mount Everest lies on the border between Nepal and China. Everest is the highest mountain on Earth at about 8,849 metres. In Nepal it is called Sagarmatha, and in Tibet, Chomolungma.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Namche Bazaar is a hillside town in the Everest region of Nepal, where trekkers rest on their way up into the Himalaya. From viewpoints near the town, families gaze at Mount Everest, the tallest mountain on Earth — Nepal holds eight of the world's ten tallest peaks.
Kathmandu's old squares are filled with tiered pagoda temples, carved wooden windows and the great white stupa of Boudhanath with its watching eyes.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Nepal on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Nepal in one breath: a country in Southern Asia, capital Kathmandu, where people speak Nepali and pay with the Nepalese rupee.
